regions.today: Dry this afternoon and evening, with sunny spells, although cloud may persist in some northern parts of the province, with light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be mostly cloudy and dry. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 15 degrees with light to moderate west to southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be dry and cloudy at first, with sunny spells in the south, extending north as the day goes on. Highest temperatures of 19 to 24 degrees with light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: High or Moderate on Monday and Tuesday.
